description: FREE, X1. Turn one X1 wallet's on-chain transaction history into a short tune you can play: use it to give an agent a recognisable sound, or to show its activity in a fun way. Deterministic: the same history always gives the same tune. Returns { wallet, signatureCount, hasSong, key, rootMidi, bpm, wave, steps, stepSeconds, notes: [{ step, rest } or { step, midi, note, freq, vel, dur }] }; a wallet with no transactions returns hasSong false. To find wallets that already have a song, call agent_radio first.

wallet.description: An X1 wallet address (base58), for example one from agent_radio.

name: agent_tune
